analysis.summary: Users must be able to log in with valid credentials to reach the inventory page; invalid or empty credentials must be rejected with an error message.

explicit_requirements.statement: Users must be able to log in to SauceDemo using valid credentials and reach the inventory page.
explicit_requirements.source_quote: Users must be able to log in to SauceDemo using valid credentials and reach the inventory page.

explicit_requirements.statement: Invalid credentials must be rejected and an error message displayed while staying on the login page.
explicit_requirements.source_quote: Invalid credentials and empty submissions must be rejected.

explicit_requirements.statement: Empty username or password must be rejected and an error message displayed.
explicit_requirements.source_quote: Empty username or password, an error message is displayed.

explicit_requirements.statement: Given standard_user / secret_sauce, the user is taken to the inventory page.
explicit_requirements.source_quote: Given standard_user / secret_sauce, the user is taken to the inventory page.

explicit_requirements.statement: Given invalid credentials, an error message is displayed and the user stays on the login page.
explicit_requirements.source_quote: Given invalid credentials, an error message is displayed and the user stays on the login page.

explicit_requirements.statement: Given empty username or password, an error message is displayed.
explicit_requirements.source_quote: Given empty username or password, an error message is displayed.

scenarios.title: Successful login with valid credentials navigates to inventory page
Login with invalid credentials shows error and remains on login page
Login with empty username shows error message
Login with empty password shows error message
Login with both username and password empty shows error message

potentially_missed_scenarios.title: Case sensitivity of username/password
potentially_missed_scenarios.rationale: The requirement does not specify whether credentials are case‑sensitive.

potentially_missed_scenarios.title: Account lockout after multiple failed attempts
potentially_missed_scenarios.rationale: No behavior described for repeated invalid logins.

potentially_missed_scenarios.title: Display of specific error message text
potentially_missed_scenarios.rationale: Exact wording of error messages is not provided.

potentially_missed_scenarios.title: Login button disabled until both fields are filled
potentially_missed_scenarios.rationale: UI behavior for empty fields is not defined.

missing_information: Behavior after multiple consecutive invalid login attempts
Supported character set and length constraints for credentials
ambiguities: Definition of "invalid credentials" (wrong username, wrong password, or both)
Whether empty username and empty password are handled together or separately
assumptions: Assume the only valid credential pair is standard_user/secret_sauce as per acceptance criteria
analysis.validation_notes: All explicit statements from the user text are captured as functional requirements and derived test scenarios.
